note: The setting a person can pick by hand instead of leaving it to the model. Ported from factory api/config/shot-blocks.json (version 2). Labels live in web/i18n/locales/*/ideas.json (ideas.scene.axes.<axis>, ideas.scene.items.<item>); 'en' is the phrase the model reads.
